rationale: At the 8.59 ns floor target, AREA 3 keeps +0.8 to +1.8 ns slack at ss 100C, so setup repair (margin <=0.4 ns) has nothing to fix: T_eff is natural reg-to-reg delay, and ports no longer limit. Among AREA 3 runs, only the two fastest (6.62/6.76 ns) used orfs RC. Round-1 setting 2 (same synthesis; cap213, timing-driven placement, post-GRT repair, cap 35%) was 1 ns slower, with 45 more repair buffers yet less cell area. Setting 1 keeps the best recipe but compacts placement (util 35, density 60) to shorten wires and trims cap-driven buffering (cap 12%); slew/cap headroom against the 295 bar is large. Setting 2 adds only timing-driven placement, isolating whether it caused that regression.
